messages:
marta: new draft up for the launch blog 7Optimize for inference9 20please quick-pass for benchmarks, EU language, and the webinar embed. Target publish Tue 04/12 08:00 PT. Doc: https://docs.redwood.in/launch/optimize-blog-draft (comments open).

chris: flagged two items 5 - need GDPR consent checkbox for EU visitors + explicit data processing language in the form. Also propose CTA variant: "Reserve a demo" (EU) vs "Try Redwood Optimize" (US).

emily-cust: happy to provide a short quote for latency/cost. permission granted to use: "Redwood cut our inference P95 latency in half and reduced per-token cost by ~5x in our workload". I can sign an approval email by EOD.

joel: social copy drafts attached in the doc. two-line X variant + 1-paragraph LinkedIn. recommend we shorten hero CTA for mobile. also let's include one tweet that references the benchmark chart.

sara: design uploaded hero v5 (contextual screenshot) and an accessibility-first alt: "Redwood console showing Optimize batch settings and throughput chart". also added CTA button states (hover/active). file name: hero_optimize_v5.png.

legal-bot: Legal quick-check 5: avoid absolute superlatives. rewrite customer quote to include context: add parenthetical "(customer workload: 512-token prompts; internal benchmark)" and require email approval from customer on file. embargo: do not share to press until we have signed quote ok.

nina: HubSpot form + hidden fields ready. please include these hidden inputs in the embed: ```html
<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="optimize_launch_q2">
<input type="hidden" name="variant" value="A">
<input type="hidden" name="lead_score" value="0">
<input type="hidden" name="cohort" value="ga">
```We will set lead_score post-submission via enrichment webhook: sample payload to staging: ```json
{"email":"test+opt@redwood.in","utm_campaign":"optimize_launch_q2","cohort":"early-access","lead_score":95}
```Routing rules: lead_score>=75 -> AE queue; 50-74 -> SDR; <50 -> marketing nurture. Also added GDPR checkbox for EU flows and a redirect URL param `consent=true`.

ops-bot: I'll run a smoke test on staging once the embed is placed. steps: 1) post blog draft to staging 2) submit test HS form with hidden fields 3) validate webhook enrichment sets lead_score 4) simulate AE queue assignment. ETA: today 2pm PT.

marta: checklist update: 1) customer quote approval email (Emily) 2) embed with hidden fields + GDPR checkbox (Nina) 3) hero assets + alt (Sara) 4) legal redline on quote/context (Legal) 5) social snippets + shorten mobile CTA (Joel) 6) ops smoke test (Ops-bot). Please reply with a :white_check_mark: when done so I can lock the publish window.

emily-cust: dropping the consented quote email now, cc'ing legal. :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: received customer approval email. legal gives conditional sign-off. please ensure the parenthetical context included under the quote in the blog.

nina: hidden fields and GDPR checkbox implemented in staging embed. test pixel fired OK. :white_check_mark:

sara: hero assets uploaded to drive + GH. mobile CTA shortened to "Reserve demo". :white_check_mark:

joel: social copy locked and scheduled in Buffer draft. linking editorial calendar. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: smoke test passed end-to-end on staging. AE routing and webhook enrichment validated. scheduled publish job queued for 04/12 08:00 PT. logs: ```text
[ok] hs-form submit -> enrichment webhook -> lead_score set 95 -> AE queue assigned
```

marta: amazing, thanks team. final note: embargo list and press contacts in the doc; do not distribute until 04/12 08:00 PT. I'll run final pre-publish review 04/11 3pm PT. please block calendar if you own a checklist item. :calendar:
